name: Caesarea Philippi
line: Caesarea Philippi was a city near Mount Hermon, the northern limit of Jesus' ministry, where Peter declared that Jesus is the Christ.

moments.title: Who do you say I am?
moments.text: Near Caesarea Philippi, Jesus asked His disciples who people say He is, then asked who they say He is. Peter answered, "You are the Christ, the Son of the living God."

moments.title: On this rock
moments.text: Jesus told Peter that his answer came from the Father in heaven. He said He would build His church on this rock, and the gates of Hades would not defeat it.

moments.title: The Son of Man must suffer
moments.text: After Peter answered, Jesus began to teach that He must suffer, be killed, and rise again after three days. Peter took Him aside and told Him He was wrong, and Jesus corrected Peter in return.
